relevant_laws.notes: Public highway, parking permission, driver and actual approach route need original source review.
relevant_laws.quote: A person, except when stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted, shall not start a vehicle which is stopped, standing or parked on a highway nor enter upon a highway unless and until such movement can be made with safety.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: ordinary motor vehicle departing a permitted parked position on a source-qualified highway
